title: Is Instinct safe to use? Three things to know before you sign up

reading.body:
Instinct is an AI personal assistant that collects user data for model training by default, with users required to opt out rather than opt in to protect their information. The system can access data from connected accounts, retain that data after disconnection, and make purchases on users' behalf using their payment methods. This represents a deployment where significant capabilities affecting user finances and privacy were made available without requiring explicit prior consent.

The failure is one of default permissions. The system was designed to assume consent for data use and financial transactions rather than requiring users to affirmatively authorize each capability. Catching this would have required either conducting privacy impact assessments before launch or implementing privacy-by-default architecture where data collection and spending powers remain disabled until users explicitly enable them.

It is not established whether these practices violate any regulation, whether users encountered harm, or what Instinct's reasoning was for these defaults.

summary:
# Summary

Instinct is a new AI personal assistant gaining popularity in Silicon Valley, but it presents significant privacy risks that users should understand before signing up. By default, Instinct can use your personal information to train its AI models unless you opt out or use the protected Vault feature. Additionally, the service can access and collect data from connected accounts, and this information may remain stored even after you disconnect those accounts. The assistant can also make purchases on your behalf using your payment methods, and any disputes fall between you and the merchant rather than with Instinct itself.

Norton emphasizes that users should not sacrifice their personal data and security for AI convenience. The company positions its Norton Family Assistant as an alternative that keeps user information private, does not use shared data to train AI models, and requires explicit user confirmation before taking actions on your behalf. Norton also makes it easy to delete any data you share with the service, allowing users to access cutting-edge AI capabilities while maintaining better control over their personal information.
